title: Regressie-analyse in het kader van causale analyse 1974 : Vaardigheidscursus data-analyse
descriptions: A course on data analysis/ in particular regression analysis within the framework of causal analysis. For secondary analysis a survey is used in which countries are units of observation: with data on economic, political and social quantities.
